⚡️ Leader’s sincere response to a Letter from a ten-year-old Student

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Following a sincere and affectionate letter sent by a ten-year-old student from Tehran to the Leader of the Revolution; in response to the student’s expression of affection, Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei wrote a letter to the student and also presented a gift in return.

A while ago, on September 14, Alireza Bakhshi Iraj—a ten-year-old student living in Tehran—wrote a heartfelt letter to the Leader of the Revolution.
​
In his letter, he expressed his affection and gratitude for the Leader's guidance and also presented him with a gift as a token of appreciation and as a contribution to helping the fighters of Islam. The text of the student's letter was as follows: In the Name of God Salam, Agha. My name is Alireza Bakhshi. I am ten years old and live in Tehran. To be honest, I don't know whether my letter will reach you or not. I wish I could talk to you in person. The truth is, we owe you so much for your guidance. This money is also to thank you and to help the fighters of Islam. Hoping to meet you, Alireza Bakhshi Iraj Shahrivar 23, 1405 [Sept. 14, 2026] P.S. Happy belated birthday! The letter reached the Leader of the Islamic Revolution. In response to the student's expression of affection, Imam Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei also wrote him a letter and, in turn, presented him with a gift. The text of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution's response to the letter of Mr. Alireza Bakhshi Iraj In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful To my dear friend, Mr. Alireza Bakhshi, May God's peace, mercy, and blessings be upon you. Thank you for your kind attention. Of course, this humble servant was born in the month of Esfand (late February/early March). In return, I offer you a gift. Although, it’s very little when considered beside your generosity. Please convey my greetings to your family. Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei Mehr 19, 1405 [Oct. 11, 2026] P.S. You have a nice handwriting.

🔊 Pezeshkian: Iran will not surrender to military aggression

📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian says Iran will not surrender to military aggression, stressing that the country will firmly resist its enemies while strengthening public resilience and addressing people’s concerns.

Speaking at a meeting on Monday, Pezeshkian said that Iran must overcome the challenges and crisis created by its enemies through public solidarity and cooperation.
​
He added that his administration is seeking to resolve problems through dialogue, noting that the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, has also granted the government certain authorities in this regard.
​
Emphasizing that no one benefits from war, the president said Iran’s enemies cannot force the country into submission through military aggression. He stressed that Iran would firmly resist its enemies’ lies and excessive demands, adding that efforts must be made to strengthen public resilience and address people’s concerns and worries.
​
Referring to the solidarity among the heads of the three branches of government, officials and the public, Pezeshkian said national unity had surprised Iran’s enemies by demonstrating the country’s resilience in the face of military attacks.
​
Elsewhere in his remarks, the president said Iran’s enemies are seeking to impose obstacles and restrictions on border trade with neighboring countries and disrupt cross-border exchanges. However, he stressed that through cooperation and coordination, Iran would thwart these attempts and plots.
